name: Should I renovate my rental property with high-end finishes or focus on durability?

mainEntity.name: Should I renovate my rental property with high-end finishes or focus on durability?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most rental properties, focusing on durability and mid-range, quality finishes is often more beneficial than using high-end materials. Tenants typically prioritize functionality and a clean, modern aesthetic over luxury finishes, and high-end materials may not yield a proportional increase in rent. Durable materials, such as vinyl plank flooring, quartz countertops, and robust cabinetry, will withstand tenant wear and tear better, reducing maintenance costs and turnover expenses in the long run. The goal is to maximize appeal and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize durable, mid-range quality finishes over high-end materials for rental properties. This reduces maintenance and appeals to a broader tenant base without overspending.
